population: ASAP tier-1 test, shortest performance per score, 14 scores

paper_summary.definition: Per-piece ratio of MUSTER onset-error rate on exact explicit non-grace tuplet notes to the rate on matched non-tuplet notes.
Per-piece ratio of MUSTER onset-error rate on exact explicit non-grace tuplet notes to the rate on matched non-tuplet notes.

_metric_defs.onset_err: fraction (%) of matched GT notes in the exact paper bucket flagged OnsetError(shift|scale) by MUSTER
_metric_defs.offset_err: fraction (%) of matched GT notes in the exact paper bucket flagged OffsetError by MUSTER
_metric_defs.tuplet_tag: exact MusicXML <time-modification> joined by Fmt3x GtID
_metric_defs.matched_population: exact GT IDs in ScoreMatchEvaluation's GT-to-EST correspondence block; this reproduces MUSTER's nGT-nMiss denominator
_metric_defs.self_consistency: note-weighted bucket errors reproduce MUSTER; the onset rhythm-correction residual is recorded explicitly
